name: @local-ai/amphi-custom-components
description: Zero-code algorithms and Java execution for Amphi

scripts.build: jlpm run validate:python && jlpm run test:runtime && jlpm run build:lib && jlpm run build:labextension
scripts.build:lib: tsc --build && tsc --build packages/amphi-ai27-components packages/amphi-ai14-components packages/amphi-ai22-components packages/amphi-ai24-components
scripts.clean: rimraf lib labextension tsconfig.tsbuildinfo packages/amphi-ai27-components/lib packages/amphi-ai27-components/labextension packages/amphi-ai27-components/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo packages/amphi-ai14-components/lib packages/amphi-ai14-components/labextension packages/amphi-ai14-components/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo packages/amphi-ai22-components/lib packages/amphi-ai22-components/labextension packages/amphi-ai22-components/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo packages/amphi-ai24-components/lib packages/amphi-ai24-components/labextension packages/amphi-ai24-components/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo
scripts.test:runtime: python scripts/test_algorithm_runtime.py && python scripts/test_csv_pipeline.py && python scripts/test_java_runtime.py && python scripts/test_script_report_runtime.py && python scripts/test_ai14_runtime.py && python scripts/test_ai22_runtime.py && python scripts/test_ai24_runtime.py
